Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:10:1.hebrew: שב בירי לשלמנא - שבע בורות כרויות לרגלי איש שלום, ומכולם ינצל:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:10:1.english: Seven pits for the man of peace - Seven pits are dug at the feet of a man of peace, and from all of them he will be saved.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:10:2.english: And one pit for the doer of evil - For one who does wickedness:

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:10:3.english: Shall fall - At the first mishap that comes upon him.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:11:1.hebrew: דמבי דינא שלקוה גלימי' - מי שנטלו ב"ד טליתו לפורעה לאחר:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:11:1.english: [One] who [leaves] the court [after] they took his cloak - One whose cloak the court took to pay [his debt] to another.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:11:2.hebrew: ליזמר וליזל - הואיל ודין אמת דנו, לא הפסיד כלום, אלא גזילה הוציאו מידו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:11:2.english: Let him sing and go - Since they judged a true judgment, he did not lose anything; rather, they removed stolen property from his possession.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:11:3.hebrew: כל העם הזה - ביתרו כתיב, ומשמע: לא שנא זכאי ולא שנא חייב — כולן במשמע:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:11:3.english: All this people - It is written in [the passage of] Yitro, and it implies: It makes no difference [whether one is] acquitted or liable — all of them are implied.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:12:1.hebrew: היא ניימא ודיקולא שפיל - כשהאשה מנמנמת, הסל שעל ראשה — שהיא נותנת בו פילכה ומלאכת ידיה — בו שפיל. כלומר: מתוך שהיא עצילה, אין מלאכתה ניכרת. וכולן משלות הן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:12:1.english: She dozes and the basket drops - When a woman dozes, the basket upon her head — in which she places her spindle and her handiwork — in it [the work] is low; that is to say: because she is lazy, her work is not noticeable. And all of them are parables.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:13:1.english: Lifted his fist and stood - He raised his fist against me and stood against me.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:14:1.english: Our love was strong - When our love was strong, between me and my wife.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:14:2.english: On the width of a sword we slept - On the width of the sword, the two of us would sleep.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:14:3.english: Is not sufficient for us - [It] is not enough for us.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:14:4.hebrew: הרי כאן עשרה - גובה מן הקרקע. הרי שהקב"ה משרה שכינתו בעשרה טפחים סמוך לקרקע, ועוד באורך הכפורת — באמתה וחצי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:14:4.english: There are ten here - [In terms of] height from the ground. Behold, the Holy One, Blessed be He, causes His Divine Presence to rest within ten handbreadths close to the ground, and furthermore, along the length of the Ark Cover — in its cubit and a half.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:15:1.hebrew: ולבסוף - בבהמ"ק היה גבוה שלשים אמה ואורכו ששים, וכשחטאו נאמר להם: "איזה בית אשר תבנו לי" — שתוכל שכינתי להיות מצומצמת בתוכו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:15:1.english: And at the end - In the Temple, [the House] was thirty cubits high and its length was sixty [cubits]; and when they sinned, it was said to them: “Where is the house that you may build for Me?” — that My Divine Presence could be confined within it.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:17:1.hebrew: עתה אקום - אסתלק משער ב"ד:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:17:1.english: Now will I arise - I will withdraw from the gate of the court.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:1:1.hebrew: מצוה למימר להו - ברישא: "אי דינא בעיתו, אי פשרה בעיתו?", דפתחינן להו בפשרה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:1:1.english: [It is] a mitzva to say to them - At the outset: "Do you want judgment, or do you want compromise?" — for we open [the proceedings] for them with compromise.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:1:2.hebrew: היינו ת"ק - דאמר: "נגמר הדין אי אתה רשאי לבצוע" — הא מקודם גמר דין רשאי לבצוע, וה"נ רשות הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:1:2.english: This is [the view of] the first tanna - For he said: “[Once] the verdict is finalized, you are not permitted to arbitrate [a compromise]” — which implies that prior to the finalization of the verdict, one is permitted to arbitrate [a compromise]; and here too, it is [merely] permitted.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:1:3.hebrew: איכא בינייהו מצוה - להזכיר פשרה; לת"ק ליכא מצוה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:1:3.english: There is [a difference] between them [with regard to] a mitzva - To mention [the option of] compromise; according to the first tanna, there is no mitzva.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:2:1.hebrew: איכא בינייהו משתשמע דבריהם - לת"ק, אפילו שמע דבריהם, רשאי לבצוע עד שיגמר הדין ויאמר: "זה זכאי וזה חייב". לר"ש בן מנסיא, משתשמע את דבריהם וידעת להיכן נוטה, אע"ג דלא נגמר — אין רשאי לבצוע:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:2:1.english: The difference between them is "Once you hear their statements" - According to the first tanna, even if he heard their statements, he is permitted to mediate until the verdict is concluded and he says: "This one is innocent and that one is liable." According to Rabbi Shimon ben Menasya, once you hear their statements and you know where [the judgment] is leaning, even though [the verdict] has not been concluded, he is not permitted to mediate.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:3:1.english: This verse - [The verse:] “And the covetous blesses” (Psalms 10:3).

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:3:2.hebrew: אלא כנגד מעשה העגל - שעשה אהרן פשרה בינו לבין עצמו, והורה היתר לעצמו לעשות להם את העגל:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:3:2.english: Only with regard to the incident of the Calf - For Aaron made a compromise within himself, and ruled it permissible for himself to make the calf for them.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:3:3.hebrew: ויבן מזבח - הבין מהזבוח לפניו, שהרגו את חור על שלא עשה להם:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:3:3.english: And he built an altar - He understood [vayyaven] from the one slaughtered [mizavuaḥ] before him that they had killed Hur because he did not make [the Calf] for them.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:3:4.english: Aaron - He was a priest and a prophet.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:4:1.hebrew: ולא הויא להו תקנתא - דהא סופן לעשות כן בזכריה בן יהוידע, ויחרב בית המקדש על כך:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:4:1.english: And they will have no remedy - For they were ultimately destined to do so to Zechariah son of Jehoiada, and the Temple was destroyed on account of this.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:1.hebrew: והני תנאי - דלית להו "משתשמע דבריהם אי אתה רשאי לבצוע" — האי "פוטר מים", מאי דרשי ביה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:1.english: And these tanna’im - Who do not hold: “Once you have heard their words, you are not permitted to compromise” — this [verse of] “Releases water,” what do they derive from it?

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:2.english: The beginning of his judgment - In the World to Come.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:3.english: Concerning matters of Torah - That he did not engage in Torah [study].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:4.hebrew: פוטר מים - שפוטר התורה מעליו, הוא ראשית מדונו. תורה נמשלה למים, דכתיב (ישעיהו נ״ה:א׳): "הוי כל צמא לכו למים":
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:4.english: One who releases water - One who casts off the Torah from upon himself — that is the beginning of his judgment. The Torah is compared to water, as it is written (Isaiah 55:1): “Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters.”

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:5.hebrew: לצינורא דבידקא - כשהנהר גדל, פעמים שהוא יוצא לשדות שעל אגפיו כעין ניגרים וצינורות קטנים, ואם אינו סותמו מיד — הולך ומרחיב, ושוב אינו יכול לסותמו. והיינו דקאמר קרא: "פוטר מים ראשית מדון" — כלומר: ראשית מדון ומריבה דומה לפוטר מים. "פוטר" — פותח, כמו "פטר רחם" (שמות יג):
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:5:5.english: To a channel of a water breach - When a river rises, at times it overflows into the fields along its banks like trickles and small channels; and if one does not dam it up immediately, it continues to widen, and he is no longer able to dam it up. And this is what the verse states: “The beginning of strife is as when one releases water,” that is to say: the beginning of strife and quarrel is similar to one who releases water. “Poter” [means] opening, as in “openeth the womb” (Exodus 13).

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:6:1.hebrew: לגודא דגמלא - דפין של גשר. בתחילה כשדורסין עליהם, מנענעות, וסוף מתחזקות ונקבעות במקומן. והכי נמי, כשאדם מרבה בקטטה — מתחזקת ובאה. ולא מקרא נפקא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:6:1.english: To a board of a bridge - Planks of a bridge. Initially, when [people] tread upon them, they shake, but in the end, they strengthen and become fixed in their place. And so too, when a person increases strife, it continually gathers strength. And [this] is not derived from a verse.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:1.hebrew: טוביה דשמע ואדיש - אשריו ששומע חרפתו ושותק, ומרגיל בכך. ואדיש — כמו דדש דש (גיטין דף נו:):
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:1.english: It is good for [one] who hears and remains silent - Happy is he who hears his insult and remains silent, and accustoms himself to this. And “adish” is like “dedash dash” [once it is accustomed, it is accustomed] (Gittin 56b).

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:2.english: A hundred misfortunes pass him by - Through his silence, a hundred misfortunes that would have come upon him through the quarrel departed.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:3.hebrew: פוטר מים - המתחיל (מדון) ופותח בקטטה, הוא תחילת מאה דיני:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:3.english: One who releases water - One who initiates (strife) and opens a quarrel is the beginning of one hundred legal disputes.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:4.hebrew: מדון - נוטריקון: מאה דני. ל"א: מדון בגימטריא מאה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:8:4.english: Strife - An acronym [notarikon]: A hundred litigations [me’a danei]. Another explanation: Madon in gematria is one hundred.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:9:1.hebrew: אתרי תלת גנבא לא מיקטיל - כלומר: אם עובר אדם עבירה פעמים ושלש ולא באה עליו פורענות — אל יתמה, דאתרי תלת גנבא לא מיקטיל, וסופו ללקות באחרונה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 7a:9:1.english: For two [or] three [thefts], a thief is not executed - That is to say, if a person commits a transgression two or three times and retribution does not come upon him, let him not wonder, as for two [or] three [thefts] a thief is not executed, but in the end he will be punished for the last one.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 7a:3:1.hebrew: כנגד מעשה העגל - אקרא ד"תורת אמת" קאי, כדכתיב בסיפיה: "ורבים השיב מעון" — שיהא להם תקנה, כדמסיק:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 7a:3:1.english: "With regard to the incident of the Calf" - [This] refers to the verse: "The law of truth [was in his mouth]" (Malachi 2:6), as it is written at its conclusion: "And he turned many away from iniquity" — [meaning] so that they would have a remedy [through repentance], as [the Gemara] concludes.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 7a:5:1.hebrew: אלא על דברי תורה - והא דאמרינן בפרק במה מדליקין (שבת דף לא.) ששואלין לו: "נשאת ונתת באמונה?", ואח"כ "קבעת עתים לתורה?" — התם באדם שעוסק בתורה מיירי, אלא שלא קבע עתים; והכא מיירי כשלא עסק כלל. אי נמי: שואלים לו תחילה על משא ומתן באמונה, ומ"מ יקבל דינו תחילה על דברי תורה. והכי דריש ליה לקרא: תחלת גילוי דינו במה שנטשו מדברי תורה:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 7a:5:1.english: Only concerning matters of Torah - And that which we say in the chapter [entitled] Bameh Madlikin (Shabbat 31a), that they ask him: "Did you conduct business faithfully?" and afterwards: "Did you set fixed times for Torah?" — there it is dealing with a person who engages in Torah [study], but did not set fixed times; whereas here it is dealing with when he did not engage [in study] at all. Alternatively: They ask him first about conducting business faithfully, but nevertheless he receives his judgment first concerning matters of Torah. And this is how [the verse] is interpreted: The beginning of the disclosure of his judgment is for having abandoned the words of Torah.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 7a:6:1.hebrew: לגודא דגמלא - וה"ק: "פוטר מים" — דהיינו גודא דגמלא, שפוטרת את האדם מן המים — כך הוא "ראשית מדון":
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 7a:6:1.english: “To a board in a bridge” - And this is what [the verse] means: “[That which] spares from water” — that is, the board of a bridge, which spares a person from the water — so is “the beginning of strife.”
